memory_candidates.title: IK box-witness sublemma needs AndI/AndE1/AndE2 beyond report 03's {h_K,h_Kdia,h_Idb}
memory_candidates.body: Transliterating ianshil/CK's general_th_completeness.v box case into CSLib's box_witness_pair_underivable (task 480, CanonicalModel.lean) requires combining the finitely many separately-used diamond context members (each an assumption `dia A_j`, A_j in u.val) into a single `dia(bigAnd A_j)` antecedent before Fischer-Servi Idb applies (mirrors ianshil/CK's prv_list_left_conj + list_conj_Diam_obj). This needs Cslib.Logic.Axioms.AndI/AndE1/AndE2 as three additional parametric hypotheses, not called out in report 03's per-lemma axiom table (which only listed h_K/h_Kdia/h_Idb + the Or-based intuitionistic base). Not new axioms -- pre-existing And-schemata already used elsewhere (MCS.lean mcs_and_mem_iff). Any future report enumerating axiom requirements for a lemma that must combine multiple modal-context hypotheses into one via a Lindenbaum/witness-pair style Zorn argument should check whether AndI/AndE are silently required.
